# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 2018321823, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a printer's wooden composing stick holding a row of smooth blank metal type blocks with no characters on them, a pair of tweezers lifting one block out and placing a new shiny gold block in its place, close up, warm workshop light, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
